div.div:
Research Atlas — ER model (Chen notation)
Rectangle: entity · Diamond: relationship · Ellipse: attribute
underlined: key attribute · dashed ellipse: derived attribute
1 / N / M: cardinality · double line: total participation
CITES and SUBTOPIC_OF are recursive; labels give the role of each side
